title: Rebuild the Vercel provider from production document structures
objective: Ingest official Vercel Hobby, Sandbox, and Pro Trial documents through header-signature matrix profiles and exact same-document assertions while making Z0 unreachable whenever the no-card condition is unknown.
out_of_scope_zero_diff: other provider profiles, configs, fixtures, and tests
publisher, classifier, quota parser, fetch MIME behavior, and shared extraction machinery
promotion or merge of the draft pull request
acceptance_criteria: A1: Vercel config declares canonical official HTML sources for Hobby, Sandbox, and Pro Trial, with all fourteen coverage states retained unless live official evidence requires a documented correction.

A2: Every production Vercel profile selects exactly one real table by normalized header signature, pivots a real tier column, and maps only exact same-document title, heading, paragraph, or list-item blocks. Mapped plus explicitly ignored row labels equal the pinned live row-label set exactly; every mapped row is required.

A3: Every retained target table includes every live data row and cell; capture.json explicitly states that no target-table row or cell was removed, records the live table header and row count, lists each ignored extraction row with a one-line non-materiality rationale, and carries an offline structural sidecar derived from the pinned live capture.

A4: Every Vercel candidate omits requires_card and has_paid_dependencies. No registered Vercel profile may assert either field: 'free', 'no billing cycles', 'will not be charged', 'you will not get charged', and upgrade-only payment instructions are not evidence for either gate. The publication gate must record decision=review with schema_complete failed, create a review item, and create zero Offer, OfferVersion, and Quota rows.

A5: The Pro Trial candidate is an evidence-backed deliberate non-Z0 control. Its trial duration, quota qualifiers, and hard-stop behavior remain verbatim; no no-card fact is asserted without owner ruling.
A6: Offline tests exercise unchanged, changed, partial, malformed, contradictory, withdrawn, and stale behaviors; withdrawn and stale use the shared cross-scan harness.

A7: Offline live-to-fixture controls compare every pinned structural-sidecar target-table header, row label, and cell to the retained fixture, and every asserted same-document prose block to its pinned hash.

A8: A session-only, uncommitted live uncontrolled fetch is run through each Vercel production profile and the exact candidate or rejection result is reported without reshaping fixtures to force acceptance.
A9: The old PR #50 synthetic ids, including vercel-hobby-offers and vercel-blob-hobby, appear nowhere in Vercel profiles or fixtures.
A10: Q9-A remains satisfied and every declared service-category mapping has a one-line rationale; every arguable mapping is disclosed in the draft PR body.

A11: Before execution, predictions are recorded for extra column, reordered columns, renamed tier header, duplicated table, rowspan, mapped-row removal, and entity/whitespace mutations. Observation must match prediction; any fail-open axis is disclosed in the draft PR body.

A12: A real PostgreSQL run persists scan_run, snapshot, candidate, official evidence, and review items for all configured sources while publishing zero offers. Each candidate records decision=review, schema_complete among failed_conditions, and SQL-scoped zero counts for Vercel Offer, OfferVersion, and Quota.
A13: Full isolated PostgreSQL tests pass with exactly two test_stack_health.py skips, Alembic head 0011, no network in tests, and no dependency or workflow change.
A14: Draft PR CI has all five checks green; Dependency audit has fourteen successful steps and all five named audit steps succeed.
verification_plan: Run targeted Vercel unit tests and fixture extraction tests offline.
Run live uncontrolled Vercel bytes through production profiles and retain structural output in session artifacts.
Run the invented mutation after recording its prediction.
Run the Vercel integration suite and full pytest suite against the isolated PostgreSQL service.
Run Alembic head and migration-drift checks.
Run a fresh Level 2 evaluator against the contract, live artifacts, implementation diff, database rows, negative controls, and publication counts.
Commit, push, open a draft pull request at the first pushed commit, wait for CI, and inspect exact check and dependency-step names.
negative_tests: Removing or changing a required live matrix row must reject rather than silently truncate the candidate.
Adding an undeclared matrix row must reject with unknown_matrix_rows.
Duplicating a matching table must reject with ambiguous_table.
No Vercel assertion may map requires_card or has_paid_dependencies, and persisted Vercel candidates must contain neither key.
A changed asserted qualifier such as First, Up to, monthly, lifetime, or since you first used the feature must reject or remain changed verbatim.
A stale or unmatched ignored_matrix_rows label must fail the profile completeness test.
Synthetic PR #50 table ids must have zero matches across apps/api/app/ingest/adapters/profiles/vercel.py and tests/fixtures/ingest/vercel/html.
data_implications: Adds source, scan, snapshot, candidate, evidence, and review rows through existing schema only. No Vercel offer, offer_version, or quota row may be created under the approved evidence set.
security_privacy: Only canonical vercel.com URLs are configured. Tests remain fixture-only and offline. No secrets, credentials, user-controlled URLs, or new egress path are introduced.
portability: Uses existing standard-library HTML extraction and existing PostgreSQL integration paths; no managed-cloud dependency or new package is added.
z0_risk: Critical. Unknown requires_card and has_paid_dependencies facts must block publication. Free, no billing cycles, will not be charged, you will not get charged, and upgrade-only card instructions are not no-card or no-paid-dependency evidence.
cost_estimate: Local development and CI use existing resources; expected incremental service cost is $0. Live reads are public official documentation requests only.
